description: Arcep publishes aggregate activity indicators for authorised postal operators and parcel operators in France. The series comes from operator surveys described in the national catalogue. The listed workbook is labelled 2005–2024. Its market-level indicators can provide service-demand context for postal and parcel capacity planning. The metadata does not establish facility locations, delivery routes or the exact variables in each worksheet. Data are available as a public Excel workbook under the Open Database License. The provider lists an annual update frequency. Only catalogue metadata and the download header were checked; workbook contents and time-series consistency remain unverified. This resource belongs to transport and logistics. Its earlier rejection under a digital-sector search is superseded by the agreed catalogue scope. The related French national catalogue records its publisher and distribution.
